title: Open Props: Animations tokens
notes:
23 CSS custom properties, e.g. --animation-fade-in, --animation-fade-in-bloom, --animation-fade-out, --animation-fade-out-bloom.

Use: npm i open-props, then @import "open-props/animations" (or copy the variables).

Original file: https://github.com/argyleink/open-props/blob/main/src/props.animations.css
